title_idea: Rout: The Only Two Times This Verb Appears, Grammar Hands the Victory to God Both Ways

At 54:45 it is PASSIVE — 'the host will be routed and turn their backs' (sa-yuhzamu al-jam'u), the human victor erased entirely and the agency left to God. Scope: ROOT field; 2 verb tokens, 2 verses.
